key.name: show-hidden
key.summary: Show hidden files and folders

key.name: media-only
key.summary: Only show pictures and videos in the browse view

key.name: show-images
key.summary: Show pictures in the browse view

key.name: show-videos
key.summary: Show videos in the browse view

key.name: thumbnail-crop
key.summary: Crop thumbnails to a square that fills the item's visual part

key.name: video-frame-previews
key.summary: Generate the frames a video plays while it is under the pointer, or is the item last selected and the pointer is over none

key.name: directory-previews
key.summary: Show a cascade of the first pictures and videos over a folder's icon

key.name: folder-preview-count
key.summary: The most pictures and videos scattered over a folder's icon

key.name: viewer-status-overlay-position
key.summary: Where the status bar floats over the viewer's item in fullscreen

key.name: viewer-status-bar
key.summary: Show a status bar under the viewer's item: its position, name, resolution, frame rate and file size

key.name: mpv-opengl
key.summary: Render videos played by libmpv with OpenGL, with the blurred backdrop drawn by a shader, rather than in software

key.name: svp-enabled
key.summary: Interpolate the frames of videos played by libmpv with SVP (SmoothVideo Project)

key.name: svp-fps-mode
key.summary: The output frame rate: the source's, a fixed target, the target divided by the speed, or the display's rate divided by the speed

key.name: svp-fps-target
key.summary: The target output frame rate for the fixed and variable modes, or 0 for the source's

key.name: svp-fps-minimum
key.summary: The lowest output frame rate SVP is given

key.name: svp-fps-maximum
key.summary: The highest output frame rate SVP is given

key.name: svp-nvof
key.summary: Use NVIDIA optical flow for SVP's motion analysis, rather than the CPU

key.name: svp-seek-bypass
key.summary: Leave SVP out of the video while it is skipped through and just after it starts, as mpv reloads SVP after every seek

key.name: svp-seek-bypass-delay
key.summary: How many seconds after the last seek SVP comes back

key.name: image-preloading
key.summary: When viewing an image, preload the adjacent images in the background

key.name: thumbnail-threads
key.summary: How many thumbnails are made at the same time, at most the number of threads on the system

key.name: thumbnail-cache
key.summary: Keep thumbnails on disk, so they are not made again the next time they are shown

key.name: thumbnail-aggression
key.summary: How eagerly thumbnails are made for items off screen: only those on screen, or those up to one, two or four pages away, or the whole folder

key.name: thumbnail-unload-offscreen
key.summary: Free the memory of thumbnails scrolled out of view, and load them again when they come back

key.name: folder-preview-fit
key.summary: Fit as many previews to a folder's icon as their pictures' dimensions allow, instead of a set number

key.name: folder-preview-cycle
key.summary: Cycle a folder's preview pictures through its media while it is under the pointer, or is the item last selected and the pointer is over none

key.name: item-size
key.summary: Size in pixels of the visual part of each browse item

key.name: collapse-on-navigate
key.summary: Collapse folders outside the current path when navigating

key.name: window-width
key.summary: Width of the window when it is not maximized

key.name: window-height
key.summary: Height of the window when it is not maximized

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the window was maximized when it was last closed

key.name: start-location
key.summary: Where a new window starts: the last open folder, the root folder, the home folder, or start-directory

key.name: start-directory
key.summary: The folder a new window starts in when start-location is specific

key.name: last-directory
key.summary: The folder open when the last window closed, used when start-location is last

key.name: last-file
key.summary: The item selected in last-directory when the last window closed, reselected on start

key.name: sidebar-width
key.summary: Sidebar width chosen by dragging, in pixels; -1 uses the default width

key.name: sidebar-bookmarks-expanded
key.summary: Whether the sidebar's bookmarks section is expanded

key.name: sidebar-filesystem-expanded
key.summary: Whether the sidebar's filesystem section is expanded

key.name: playlist-fetch-in-background
key.summary: Whether the playlist reads the lengths of its items in the background, rather than when each is first played

key.name: playlist-show-position
key.summary: Whether the playlist shows the position column

key.name: playlist-show-name
key.summary: Whether the playlist shows the name column

key.name: playlist-show-length
key.summary: Whether the playlist shows the length column

key.name: playlist-show-filename
key.summary: Whether the playlist shows the filename column

key.name: playlist-column-widths
key.summary: The widths of the playlist's columns, in the order they are shown in, with -1 for a column that sizes itself

key.name: playlist-sort
key.summary: The column the playlist is sorted by, by its name, and whether it is sorted descending; an empty name is no sort

key.name: playlist-shown
key.summary: Whether the playlist is shown beside the browse view

key.name: playlist-width
key.summary: The width of the playlist beside the browse view, or -1 for the default

key.name: playlist-detached
key.summary: Whether the playlist is in a window of its own

key.name: playlist-window-width
key.summary: The width of the playlist's own window

key.name: playlist-window-height
key.summary: The height of the playlist's own window

key.name: playlist-window-headerbar
key.summary: The header of the playlist's own window: full, compact (half the height, with a smaller title), or none

key.name: playlist-repeat
key.summary: Whether the playlist goes back to its first item after its last, and the other way round

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar
key.summary: The side of the viewer the thumbnail bar is on

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-shown
key.summary: Show the thumbnail bar in the viewer

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-overlay
key.summary: Float the thumbnail bar over the picture, rather than beside it

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-pinned
key.summary: Keep the floating thumbnail bar shown, rather than only while the pointer is near it

key.name: viewer-thumbnail-bar-size
key.summary: The size of the thumbnails in the viewer's thumbnail bar, in pixels

key.name: open-fullscreen
key.summary: Open the viewer in fullscreen

key.name: auto-hide-cursor
key.summary: Hide the mouse cursor while the viewer is idle

key.name: smooth-scrolling
key.summary: Animate zooming and panning of images, rather than jumping to the new view

key.name: image-info-in-title
key.summary: Show the image's file name and details in the window title

key.name: zoom-indicator
key.summary: Show the zoom level: on, off, or only when the image is zoomed

key.name: image-fit
key.summary: How an image is sized when it is opened: to fit the window, its width or its height, to cover the window, or at its own size

key.name: original-focus
key.summary: Where an image shown at its own size sits: its top at the top of the window, its centre in the middle, or the point under the pointer kept in place

key.name: unlock-minimum-zoom
key.summary: Let zooming out go below the image's own size; locked, zooming out stops at 100%

key.name: scaling-filter
key.summary: How images are resampled when drawn: nearest keeps pixels sharp, linear smooths them, cubic smooths them with more detail, and the sharp ones sharpen the result

key.name: keep-fit-mode
key.summary: Keep the fit mode when switching images

key.name: video-backend
key.summary: What plays videos: libmpv, or GStreamer through GTK's own media backend

key.name: overlay-layout
key.summary: The elements of the media overlay and where they sit, as JSON. While empty, the older seek overlay and status overlay settings make the layout

key.name: seek-overlay
key.summary: Show a progress bar and the time over a video when it is skipped through

key.name: seek-overlay-bar
key.summary: Show a progress bar in the seek overlay

key.name: seek-overlay-time
key.summary: Show the time in the seek overlay

key.name: seek-overlay-time-format
key.summary: How the seek overlay writes the time: elapsed and total, remaining and total, or just one of them

key.name: seek-overlay-position
key.summary: Where the seek overlay sits over the video

key.name: seek-overlay-seconds
key.summary: How long the seek overlay stays up after a skip, in seconds

key.name: seek-overlay-width
key.summary: The width of the seek overlay's progress bar, in pixels

key.name: seek-overlay-always
key.summary: Keep the seek overlay up while a video plays, rather than only after a skip

key.name: remember-file-settings
key.summary: Keep settings for each file, such as where a video was left, and use them when the file is shown again

key.name: remember-position
key.summary: Keep where a video was left, and start it there next time

key.name: remember-speed
key.summary: Keep the playback speed of a video

key.name: remember-volume
key.summary: Keep the volume and mute state of a video

key.name: remember-rotation
key.summary: Keep how a picture or video was turned and mirrored

key.name: remember-zoom
key.summary: Keep how a picture was zoomed, or its fit mode

key.name: remember-pan
key.summary: Keep where a zoomed picture was panned to

key.name: sidebar-animations
key.summary: Slide the sidebars and the thumbnail bar in and out, rather than showing and hiding them at once

key.name: sidebar-animation-ms
key.summary: How long the sidebars and the thumbnail bar take to slide in and out, in milliseconds

key.name: video-crop
key.summary: Crop the black bars, or the backdrop, off the edges of a video that mpv plays

key.name: video-crop-method
key.summary: How the picture to crop to is found: mpv's near-black border detector, the brightness steps at the picture's border, or the area that moves

key.name: video-crop-trim
key.summary: Pixels trimmed from each side that was cropped, so a soft edge is not left in

key.name: video-backdrop
key.summary: Fill the space round a video with a blurred, dimmed copy of it

key.name: video-backdrop-zoom
key.summary: How far the copy behind the picture is zoomed in

key.name: video-backdrop-blur
key.summary: How blurred the copy behind the picture is

key.name: video-backdrop-dim
key.summary: How bright the copy behind the picture is, from 0 for black to 1 for unchanged

key.name: video-controls-locked
key.summary: Keep the video controls where they are. Unlocked, they can be dragged to a new place over the video, and their left or right edge dragged to change their width

key.name: video-controls-x
key.summary: The centre of the video controls across the video frame, from 0 at the left to 1 at the right

key.name: video-controls-y
key.summary: The centre of the video controls down the video frame, from 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom

key.name: video-controls-width
key.summary: The width of the video controls as a share of the video frame, or 0 for the width they need

key.name: mpv-args
key.summary: Extra mpv command line options for the mpv player, such as --hwdec=auto-copy

key.name: video-start-delay
key.summary: How long, in milliseconds, a video waits to start after stepping to it with next or previous; 0 starts it at once

key.name: zoom-step
key.summary: How much one zoom step enlarges or shrinks the picture, in percent

key.name: expand-up-to-factor
key.summary: Largest zoom, as a multiple of their own size, that small images are enlarged to when fitted; 0 has no limit

key.name: smooth-upscaling
key.summary: Smooth pixels when images are enlarged, rather than drawing them as blocks; off uses nearest for enlarged images

key.name: filename-display
key.summary: How item names are shown: off, wrapped to two lines, or ellipsized

key.name: show-directories
key.summary: Where folders are listed: not at all, before and after the files as the sort order says, or among the files

key.name: sort-by
key.summary: What the browse view sorts files and folders by, in a folder with no remembered sort: name, modification time, size or type

key.name: sort-order
key.summary: Whether the browse view sorts ascending or descending, in a folder with no remembered sort

key.name: remember-folder-sort
key.summary: Keep the sort chosen in the sort menu for that folder alone, rather than changing the default

key.name: folder-end
key.summary: What stepping past either end of a folder in the viewer does: stop, loop around the folder, or go on to the next folder with media

key.name: info-layout
key.summary: How item info is laid out: disabled, one field per line, or fields separated by bullets

key.name: info-fields
key.summary: Details shown under each item's name

key.name: ipc-socket
key.summary: Serve the JSON IPC on a Unix socket in the runtime directory

key.name: ipc-socket-path
key.summary: Where the Unix socket is; empty for rsimgv.sock in the runtime directory

key.name: ipc-tcp-enabled
key.summary: Serve the JSON IPC on a TCP port

key.name: ipc-tcp-port
key.summary: The TCP port the JSON IPC is served on, when TCP is enabled

key.name: ipc-http-enabled
key.summary: Serve the JSON IPC over HTTP

key.name: ipc-http-port
key.summary: The HTTP port the JSON IPC is served on, when HTTP is enabled

key.name: ipc-external-access
key.summary: Let other machines reach the TCP and HTTP IPC ports, rather than only localhost

key.name: viewer-blurred-background
key.summary: Show a blurred, dimmed, cropped copy of the picture behind it in the viewer

key.name: scripts
key.summary: Scripts listed in the preferences, each a JSON object with its name, command and wait flag

key.name: mouse-back
key.summary: What the mouse's back button does: back, up, previous, next, forward, or none

key.name: mouse-forward
key.summary: What the mouse's forward button does: back, up, previous, next, forward, or none

key.name: scroll-image
key.summary: What the scroll wheel does over a picture: zoom with Ctrl, zoom, step between items, or nothing

key.name: scroll-video
key.summary: What the scroll wheel does over a video: volume, seek, step between items, or nothing

key.name: scroll-speed
key.summary: How far each notch of the scroll wheel moves, in percent of the normal amount
